bundle.shortDescription: Show your phone's screen on your PC
bundle.longDescription: Free, open-source phone mirroring: see, hear and control Android phones (scrcpy), and see and hear iPhones over AirPlay (UxPlay). No account, no watermark, no time limit, no telemetry.
